info.name: Distributed Hotel Booking - Route Checks
info.description: Route checks for the current repository. Set blank username/loginEmail/loginPassword and ID variables before sending. Base URLs are prefilled. Requests are not run automatically; write and delete methods mutate data. NotificationService has no HTTP routes. State and city by-ID routes are available through the gateway; physical-room by-ID is not included because HotelService has no matching handler.

item.name: 01 - Auth

request.description: Fill username, loginEmail, and loginPassword collection variables before sending. Public endpoint; sends those values to your local API and creates an account.
Fill loginEmail and loginPassword collection variables first. A successful login saves the response access token for protected requests.
